channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Microsoft Alumni Score Funding to Build AI Agents for Finance
item.description: Hyphenate Inc. has raised $45 million in a funding round led by Nexus Venture Partners, securing capital for an effort to create AI agents that can run finances for businesses.
item.dc:creator: Saritha Rai

item.title: JPMorgan Private Bank on How to Balance AI Exposure
item.description: Madison Faller, investment strategist at JPMorgan Private Bank, says investors can balance AI exposure with quality credit and real assets. She speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: How XDS Datacentres Cools Its Chips in Saudi Arabia
item.description:
How do you keep a data center cool in Saudi Arabia? That's one of the questions Ikaraam Ullah, chief strategy officer at XDS Datacentres, answers in this interview at the BloombergNEF Summit London on Oct. 20, 2026.
Ullah also discusses recent tensions the Gulf region and the impact on data center operators, and how retrofitting existing facilities can help firms tackle issues over their power and water use in the UK and elsewhere in Europe. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Infineon to Invest €1.1 Billion in Key Austrian Chip Factory
item.description: Infineon Technologies AG will spend €1.1 billion ($1.2 billion) over eight years to expand its key power chip factory in Austria, a bet on growing demand for energy-efficient semiconductors for AI data centers, electric vehicles and robotics.
item.dc:creator: Shona Ghosh

item.title: Anthropic Brings Mega IPO to Australia’s AI-Starved Retail Crowd
item.description: Anthropic PBC will offer shares as part of its blockbuster initial public offering directly to Australian investors, bringing a fresh artificial-intelligence bet to a market still reeling from the high-profile collapse of a data center deal.
item.dc:creator: Carmeli Argana

item.title: What Anthropic's IPO Means for the AI Trade
item.description: Anthropic is expected to raise more money in its initial public offering than any company in history and plans to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. Its public market performance might cement or capsize Wall Street’s confidence in the AI boom at a moment when investors are increasingly anxious about the borrowing binge underpinning it. Matt Bloxham of Bloomberg Intelligence has the details. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: From Blackouts to Surplus: How Eskom Turned South Africa’s Power Around
item.description: After enduring years of crippling power cuts, South Africa’s state utility Eskom has swung to an operational surplus, maintaining 3 to 5 gigawatts of excess generation capacity, according to CEO Dan Marokane. Yet across Johannesburg, localized outages persist as the city works to strengthen its finances and manage its power network. Speaking to Bloomberg’s Jennifer Zabasajja on Next Africa, Marokane discusses the city’s progress on settling overdue electricity bills and plans to ring-fence electricity revenue. He also outlines how Eskom’s recovery is enabling cross-border exports to neighboring southern African states, and explains why reliable electricity is central to rebuilding Johannesburg’s economy. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Oil Shock, AI Boom Deepen Divide in Emerging Asian Currencies
item.description: Surging oil prices and the AI boom are widening a currency-market divide, deepening losses across most emerging Asian currencies while providing a buffer for others, such as the Korean won.
item.dc:creator: Marcus Wong

item.title: Anthropic’s IPO May See CBA Sitting on Multi-Billion Windfall
item.description: Anthropic PBC’s initial public offering may give Commonwealth Bank of Australia an opportunity to cash in on a stake it purchased in the artificial intelligence startup more than a year ago and whose valuation has ballooned.
item.dc:creator: Richard Henderson

item.title: BNY CFO on AI Strategy, Business Growth
item.description: Dermot McDonogh, Global CFO at BNY, discusses his outlook on the bank's growth and business strategies, as well as how he is monitoring AI so as to avoid overspending on related tools. He speaks exclusively with Paul Allen and Haidi Stroud Watts on "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: BlackRock’s Rieder Spent Weekend Doing Deals in AI Debt Rush
item.description: The AI-driven debt boom is creating some of the most attractive fixed-income opportunities in years, eclipsing the appeal of long-dated US Treasuries, according to BlackRock’s Rick Rieder.
item.dc:creator: Haidi Lun, Paul Allen and David Finnerty

item.title: AI Fund a ‘Fiscal Dam’, Says South Korea Budget Minister
item.description: In an exclusive conversation with Bloomberg's Heesu Lee, South Korean budget minister Park Hong Keun says that the fund financed by semiconductor-driven tax gains will serve as a fiscal dam to cushion from higher yields (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AI Fund a ‘Fiscal Dam’, Says South Korea Budget Minister
item.description: In an exclusive conversation with Bloomberg's Heesu Lee, South Korean budget minister Park Hong Keun says that the fund financed by semiconductor-driven tax gains will serve as a fiscal dam to cushion from higher yields (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: South Korea’s AI Fund Offers ‘Fiscal Dam’ Against Higher Yields
item.description: As nations across the globe grapple with a surge in borrowing costs, almost none enjoy the option now being eyed in South Korea: deploying a major new source of cash to simply cut back on selling debt.
item.dc:creator: Heesu Lee and Jaehyun Eom

item.title: Anthropic’s IPO Sets Up Defining Moment for Wall Street and AI Boom
item.description: Anthropic PBC’s initial public offering is laying bare the extremes of the multi-trillion-dollar AI boom business model: extraordinary growth paired with uncertainty about demand and the spending required to continue developing the technology. The startup, which publicly filed IPO paperwork on Monday, is poised to be the first major US firm focused solely on building AI software to make its market debut.
item.dc:creator: Shirin Ghaffary

item.title: Iran War Boosts Malaysian Data Center Appeal, SD Guthrie Says
item.description: Malaysia is expected to attract more interest as a data center hub following the outbreak of the US-Iran war, according to SD Guthrie Bhd., giving the palm oil giant and the country’s biggest landowner an opportunity to capitalize on the boom.
item.dc:creator: Anuradha Raghu and Ram Anand

item.title: Spain Eases Data Center Energy Rules in Win for Big Tech
item.description: Spain is easing rules for data center power usage and granting them more time to adapt to the new framework, after an initial government proposal faced strong industry backlash.
item.dc:creator: Clara Hernanz Lizarraga

item.title: Applied Materials Boosts BE Semiconductor Stake to About 20%
item.description: Applied Materials Inc. boosted its stake in fellow chip-equipment maker BE Semiconductor Industries NV and said it plans to work more closely with the European company, which is becoming a more important part of the AI computing supply chain.
item.dc:creator: Nick Turner

item.title: SK Hynix, Samsung, Kioxia, CXMT Earnings Test AI Boom in Memory Market
item.description: From South Korea to Japan and China, the world’s biggest memory chipmakers will this week seek to quell fears that AI spending is outpacing future demand. How they handle back-to-back earnings disclosures and investors’ questions will help determine the trajectory for markets and shed light on the broader outlook for the artificial intelligence industry.
item.dc:creator: Yoolim Lee and Winnie Hsu

item.title: Meta Increases Equity Offering Target to Almost $98 Billion
item.description: Meta Platforms Inc. boosted a planned share sale to almost $98 billion, marking one of the largest equity offerings in history.
item.dc:creator: David Morris
